name: Validate Feature Activation Logic
description: When modifying feature activation logic, automatically validate against requirements

action.message: The feature activation logic was just modified. Please validate this change against the requirements in .kiro/specs/snapdragon-fod-aws/requirements.md, specifically checking: 1) Transaction processing (Req 1.1), 2) Time-limited activation (Req 1.2, 1.5), 3) Feature configuration (Req 1.4), and 4) State persistence (Req 1.6). Report any deviations.
